screens.title: Settings
screens.notes: Settings main menu

screens.title: Search settings
screens.notes: Top app bar holds a single search text field with placeholder "Search settings" and a clear (X) button. Results list: each row shows the preference title, a breadcrumb line "Category > Group" and the preference subtitle; tapping opens that settings screen scrolled to the preference. Empty state shows "No results found".

screens.title: Appearance
screens.notes: App theme row: a segmented button row (System / Light / Dark) above a horizontally scrolling row of theme preview cards (mini app mockups) with the theme name under each; selected card has a check badge. Pure black switch is disabled when theme mode is Light. Changing the start screen shows a "Requires app restart to take effect" toast. Search toolbar action exists on every SearchableSettings screen in two-pane mode only; listed for completeness.

screens.title: App language
screens.notes: Plain list of languages. First row "Default" (follow system), then every locale from locales_config sorted by display name. Each row: headline = language name in its own locale, supporting text = name in current locale; trailing primary-coloured check icon on the active language. Tapping applies immediately.

screens.title: Library
screens.notes: Edit categories rows open the Categories screen (anime / manga tab) outside settings. Default category list options are "Always ask" followed by every user category.

screens.title: Reader
screens.notes: Short-edge cutout switch only enabled when fullscreen is on, Android 9+ and the device has a display cutout. Flash sliders/list enabled only when flash on page change is on; flash duration subtitle "100 ms", interval subtitle "1 page". Tap-inversion and pan rows disabled when navigation layout is Disabled; landscape zoom only for Fit screen; dual-page invert only when split is on; rotate-invert only when rotate is on. Split and rotate are mutually exclusive. Webtoon side padding subtitle shows a percentage (0%).

screens.title: Player
screens.notes: Second-level menu styled like the main settings menu: each row has a leading icon (play-circle, gesture, memory chip, subtitles, audio track, terminal, edit-note, magnet, code), title and summary. Title is "Player" when opened from Settings and "Player settings" when opened from inside the player. Search opens player-only settings search (placeholder "Search player settings").

screens.title: Downloads and storage

dialogs.title: Anime Categories
dialogs.text: Entries in excluded categories will not be downloaded even if they are also in included categories.

dialogs.title: Manga Categories
dialogs.text: Entries in excluded categories will not be downloaded even if they are also in included categories.

screens.notes: Speed limit subtitle is "Off" or "N KiB/s"; its dialog uses an outlined numeric chooser (+/- buttons, step 100, suffix KiB/s). Excluded-category multi lists contain the user's categories (dynamic). Auto-download sub-rows disabled while their parent switch is off. External downloader list = "None" plus installed IDM / ADM apps.

screens.title: Sources and tracking

items.title: One-way sync to update the chapter progress in external tracker services. Set up tracking for individual entries from their tracking button.
Show adult (18+) titles
items.subtitle: While this is off, sources that know a title's rating leave adult titles out, and extensions marked 18+ are hidden.

items.title: This does not prevent unofficial or potentially incorrectly flagged extensions from surfacing NSFW (18+) content within the app.

screens.notes: Toggling the NSFW switch requires device authentication.

screens.title: Repositories

dialogs.title: Add repo
dialogs.text: Add additional repos to Kurobayomi. This should be a URL that ends with "index.min.json".

dialogs.title: Delete repo
dialogs.text: Do you wish to delete the repo "https://example.org"?

dialogs.title: Signing Key Fingerprint Already Exists
dialogs.text:
Repository New has the same Signing Key Fingerprint as Old.
If this is expected, Old will be replaced, otherwise contact your repo maintainer.

dialogs.title: Add repo
dialogs.text: Do you wish to add the repo "https://example.org"?

screens.notes: The one list of repository links, for both anime and manga sources: label icon + repo name; icon buttons open in browser, copy to clipboard, delete. Extended FAB "Add". Errors: "Invalid repo URL", "This repo already exists!".

screens.title: Backup and restore

items.title: Holds downloads (Anime, Manga), backups and local folders. A new location is used for new downloads after a restart; files already there stay where they are.

You should keep copies of backups in other places as well. Backups may contain sensitive data including any stored passwords; be careful if sharing.

Last automatically backed up: Today
Clear Manga database
items.subtitle: Delete history for manga that are not saved in your library

items.title: Clear Anime database
items.subtitle: Delete history for anime that are not saved in your library

screens.notes: Backup row is a full-width two-segment button: "Create backup" (opens Create backup screen) | "Restore backup" (opens a file chooser, then the Restore backup screen). Storage usage row shows a progress bar of used/total disk space with the text above. "Storage" (with storage icon) opens the Storage tab (outside settings). Export opens a checkbox dialog (Type/Author/Artist require Title), then a CSV save picker (aniyomi_library.csv). Help action opens the storage FAQ.

screens.title: Create backup

items.title: Include sensitive settings (e.g., tracker login tokens)

screens.notes: Rows are labeled checkboxes inside section cards (titles Library / Settings / Extensions). Chapters, tracking, history and non-library entries are disabled unless Entries is checked; private settings disabled unless app or source settings are checked. A full-width "Create" button is pinned at the bottom (opens a save-file picker). On MIUI with optimization disabled a warning banner "Backup/restore may not function properly if MIUI Optimization is disabled." is shown on top.

screens.title: Restore backup
screens.notes: Checkboxes in one section card, full-width "Restore" button pinned at the bottom. If the backup is incomplete an extra card lists "You may need to install any missing extensions and log in to tracking services afterwards to use them." plus missing sources ("Missing sources:") and trackers ("Trackers not logged into:"); invalid files show "Invalid backup file:" with the error.

screens.title: Debug info
screens.notes: Info rows are plain title/subtitle rows with no action. Device info may include a "OneUI version" or "MIUI version" row after Model on those devices.

screens.title: Worker info
screens.notes: Horizontally scrollable monospace text dump with three sections, each a titleMedium heading followed by text: "Enqueued", "Finished", "Running". Each WorkManager job lists Id, Tags, State, next schedule; "-" when empty. Copy action copies all text.

screens.title: Backup file schema
screens.notes: Vertically scrollable monospace text showing the generated protobuf schema of the backup format, 16dp padding. Copy action copies it.

screens.title: Clear Manga database

dialogs.title: Are you sure? Completed episodes and chapters and progress of non-library entries will be lost

screens.notes: List of sources that have non-library entries in the database. Each 56dp row: source icon, source name (bodyMedium) with "12 non-library entries in database" below, trailing checkbox; selected rows get a tinted background. Full-width "Delete" button pinned at the bottom, enabled when something is selected. The confirm dialog shows only the text as its body. Toast after clearing: "Entries deleted".

screens.title: Clear Anime database

dialogs.title: Are you sure? Completed episodes and chapters and progress of non-library entries will be lost

screens.notes: List of sources that have non-library entries in the database. Each 56dp row: source icon, source name (bodyMedium) with "12 non-library entries in database" below, trailing checkbox; selected rows get a tinted background. Full-width "Delete" button pinned at the bottom, enabled when something is selected. The confirm dialog shows only the text as its body. Toast after clearing: "Entries deleted". (Note: the anime screen labels both toolbar actions "Select all" in source.)

screens.title: About
screens.notes: Top: centred app logo header with divider. Version row copies debug info to clipboard. Check-for-updates row (only when updater is enabled) shows a trailing spinner while checking, then toasts "No new updates available" or opens the new-update screen. What's new is hidden on debug builds. Bottom: centred row of three icon links: "Website" (globe), Discord, GitHub.

screens.title: Open source licenses
screens.notes: AboutLibraries list: each row shows library name, author, version on the right, and license chips. Tap opens the library license screen.

screens.title: Library name
screens.notes: Title = library name. Body = HTML-rendered license text, scrollable, padded. Website action shown when the library has a URL.
